site_description: The registered non-profit that runs and funds mementomori.social.

home_intro_1: Mementomori ry is a registered non-profit in Finland. It runs and funds the
home_intro_2: social media platform, keeping it independent and member-supported.
membership_intro: Membership funds the platform and gives you a say in how the association is run. Using mementomori.social stays free for everyone, member or not. The larger fee does not buy more influence: voting rights belong to regular members.
tier_member_sub: The basic membership option, meant for people who want to support what we do.
tier_patron_sub: The supporting membership for individuals, companies and organisations with a bigger contribution.
benefit_vote: Right to vote at the association meeting
benefit_speak: Right to attend and speak at the association meeting
benefit_matrix: Access to the members' channel on Matrix
benefit_feeling: A nice feeling you are supporting a good cause
fees_note: Fees are fixed and set by the association meeting. The monthly option is an instalment of the annual fee. Joining fee is 0 €, and membership is approved by the board.
money_costs: Running the mementomori.social infrastructure, websites and social media service costs {monthly} € a month, about {annual} € a year.
join_intro: The board reviews every application. Membership begins when the board approves it, and if an application is not approved, any fee already paid is refunded in full.
choice_masto_desc: Your details are fetched directly from mementomori.social through its API: your name is prefilled and your avatar shows on the member list. From then on you sign in with your Mastodon account.

sponsor_intro: Organisations can support the association by sponsoring. Sponsorship is a service agreement: the sponsor is acknowledged publicly, and the terms are agreed in a written contract.
sponsor_what_1: A public acknowledgement on this site and in the association’s communications
sponsor_what_2: A named mention in the association’s annual report
sponsor_what_3: An account on independent, digitally sovereign, EU-based social media that stays running
login_magic_note: We email you a sign-in link. No password needed.
footer_open_source: This site is open source too
safer_intro: Mementomori ry and mementomori.social follow the safer space principles. They describe what we expect from everyone on the platform and in the association’s channels, and what you can expect from us.
safer_1: Be kind and assume good intentions. You do not have to agree with everyone, and you still treat them as people.
safer_2: No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, ableism or any other discrimination.
safer_3: No harassment. Disagreement never entitles anyone to slurs, pile-ons or hate campaigns.
safer_4: Respect boundaries. Use content warnings as the community expects, and take blocks and mutes gracefully.
safer_5: Make room. Not every conversation needs your take, and quieter voices get space here.
safer_6: Mistakes happen. When told you have hurt someone, listen, apologise and adjust.
safer_report: If you experience or witness something that breaks these principles, report it on mementomori.social or write to the moderators. Reports are handled by people, confidentially.
safer_read_more: Read more about the principles for a safer space
